content: From where I am, it seems like Loogle is down (giving me a 502). Is it an isolated issue, or can anyone else confirm the same is happening?
Just happened to me as well
Should be back up now.
It's back! :tada:
Looks like it is down again, cc @Joscha Mennicken
... and now it's back!
You pinging me scared it into behaving apparently, since I didn't touch it this time.
This happens to me semi-regularly. Loogle 502's and then 30 seconds – 2 minutes later it's back.
Probably all the agent armadas every second Lean hobbyist is running nowadays?
I've had the impression it's been particularly bad the last week or so.
I wonder if we should be building a loogle database as part of Mathlib CI. Then these AI companies might start using it locally (or individuals could too).
It is currently happening to me...
I got a 502 again
I had a 504 for a change...
still 502
oh it's back now
and it's gone agani
it's back again
loogle seems to be down now
502 Bad Gateway
Is it worth looking at the user agent string loogle is receiving to try and work out if there is an accidental bad actor who can be pinged?

It could be perhaps part of this phenomenon, if that continued :
Joachim Breitner said:

A big fraction of queries at the moment are from an AI agent at Meta it seems (meta-externalagent/1.1). Does anyone here know more about what that is? If this is some form of training or heavy internal use, it may be more convenient for everyone to run your own local instance of loogle, happy to advise :-)

Loogle seems to be getting some elevated traffic from lean-lsp-mcp until it starts refusing concurrent requests. But hardware resources are not a concern yet so I've scaled up the number of Loogle instances until Joachim can take a closer look
